pages.title: Proteins
pages.text: Proteins are rich, sustaining foods. $(#e05252)Penalty:$() reduced attack damage when depleted. $(#52c252)Bonus:$() increased max health when maintained. Cooked meats and fish are your primary sources.

pages.title: Vanilla Meat Sources
pages.text:
$(bold)Cooked Beef$() — highest nutrition of vanilla meats; keep a cow farm.
$(bold)Cooked Porkchop$() — nearly equal to beef; pigs breed quickly.
$(bold)Cooked Chicken$() — lower nutrition but very common and fast to farm.
$(bold)Cooked Mutton$() — solid mid-tier protein from sheep.
$(bold)Cooked Rabbit$() — lower yield but easy to obtain in the wild early on.

pages.title: Fish Sources
pages.text:
$(bold)Cooked Salmon$() and $(bold)Cooked Cod$() are excellent early-game proteins available near any river or ocean before you have an animal farm established.

Fishing also yields $(bold)Tropical Fish$() which counts as Proteins, though it has low nutrition. Use it as a supplement rather than a primary source.

pages.title: Proteins — Fish
pages.text:
Cooked salmon and cod are excellent protein sources and easy to obtain near any river or ocean. A fishing rod from early game makes this group trivial to maintain before any farm is built.

Auto-fishing farms are very effective for this group if you want a fully passive protein supply.

pages.title: Non-Meat Proteins
pages.text:
Not all proteins come from animals. Several plant-based and processed foods also count:

$(bold)Cooked Chicken Egg$() (if enabled) — high nutrition density.
$(bold)Mushroom Stew$() — counts as Proteins in many configurations.

Check tooltips on any food item to confirm which group it belongs to on your server.

pages.title: Farming Tips
pages.text:
A cow, pig, and chicken pen near your base covers three distinct protein families at once. Breed them regularly — you want a surplus, not just enough to survive.

If you are playing early-game without a farm, keep a fishing rod ready. Fishing covers Proteins reliably with no infrastructure required and also produces bonus loot.

pages.title: Rotation Strategy
pages.text:
Each animal type is its own protein family. Eating beef, then porkchop, then chicken gives better returns than eating three steaks in a row.

Fish counts as a separate family from land meat — switching between a cooked salmon and cooked beef at the same meal is an easy way to avoid diminishing returns on both.
